evidence.signature: inspect(handle: str, analyzer: JediAnalyzer) -> dict[str, Any]

extractor: new: the inspect Node's universal fields and what each holds, read from pyeye.mcp.operations.inspect.inspect
problem: The universal-fields table says `docstring` is the "First paragraph of docstring". inspect returns the whole raw docstring (`jedi_name.docstring(raw=True)`), every paragraph, or null; inspect on this very function returns its Args and Returns sections too.
replacement: Bind the universal-field table to a new inspect-node fact (or link docs/reference/ for it) instead of hand-writing it; until then the `docstring` row reads "The symbol's full docstring, raw, or null when it has none".

problem: The kind-dependent table lists an `attributes` field for classes ("Public attributes with types"), and the TypeRef section repeats it ("the `type` field on `attributes`"). A class node has no `attributes` field: _build_class_fields returns only `superclasses` and `signature`. Class attributes are separate `attribute`-kind handles reached through `members`, each with its own `type`. The table also omits fields inspect does return (`is_async`/`is_classmethod`/`is_staticmethod`, `is_package`/`package`, `type`/`default`).
replacement: Delete the `attributes` row and the `attributes` mention in the TypeRef section's first sentence (say "the `type` field on attribute, property and variable nodes"), and point the kind-dependent fields at the executed inspect example in skills/python-explore/SKILL.md rather than listing them by hand.

extractor: new: inspect's deprecated response fields (re_exports, #393/#749), read from pyeye.mcp.operations.inspect
problem: The Re-exports section (and the `re_exports` rows in the kind-dependent table and the absence-vs-zero list) present inspect's `re_exports` field as the current way to get a symbol's aliases. The field is deprecated in favour of `expand(handle, "re_exports")` (#393) and is to be removed in v3.0 (#749); it is also absent, not just for modules, when any file in the package couldn't be parsed. A reader adopting it today builds on a field that is going away.
replacement: Add a note at the top of the Re-exports section: "`re_exports` on inspect is deprecated; use `expand(handle, \"re_exports\")` (see docs/reference/edges.md)." Bind the deprecation through the new fact, and keep the rest of the section as the design record.

problem: States future work as fact; no issue or record backs it.
replacement: Delete "; future passes will tighten coverage", leaving "The response stays conformant."
subject: future passes will tighten coverage
